fields.label: MOSFET gate GPIO
fields.help: -1 disables the output. Must not be a strapping pin: a boot-time pull-up there would energise the heater on every reset. Fit a 10k gate pull-down regardless.

fields.label: Active-low drive
fields.help: On for gate drivers or level shifters that invert. Leave off for a plain logic-level N-MOSFET.

fields.label: PWM frequency
fields.help: 200 Hz suits a resistive/PTC load. Higher only raises switching losses.

fields.label: Max duty
fields.help: Caps the output. Use it to fit the heater inside the power budget of the supply.

fields.label: Soft start
fields.help: Ramp time from 0 to target duty. A cold PTC draws several times its steady-state current; without a ramp that inrush trips small mains modules.

fields.label: Enclosure probe id
fields.help: Sensor id measuring the heated enclosure, e.g. the DS18B20 on the heater. Required.

fields.label: Enclosure metric
fields.help: Usually temperature. For the second probe on a shared 1-Wire bus use temperature_1.

fields.label: Dew-point source id
fields.help: Optional. Sensor id publishing dew_point, e.g. the BME680. Empty disables condensation protection.

fields.label: Frost setpoint
fields.help: Minimum enclosure temperature. 5 °C keeps an SPS30 well inside its -10 °C floor without drying the sample air enough to bias PM readings.

fields.label: Dew-point margin
fields.help: Hold the enclosure at least this far above the dew point.

fields.label: Hysteresis
fields.help: Total width of the switching band around the target.

fields.label: Over-temperature cutoff
fields.help: Latches the output off above this. Keep it below the sensor's maximum rating and below the thermal fuse.

fields.label: Probe timeout
fields.help: Force the heater off when the enclosure probe has been silent this long.
